messages:
alin: quick sync 16: we need a tight preflight for FP8/INT8/4-bit canary. prefer a compact matrix to reduce infra cost.
cheng: agree. minimal matrix: baseline (FP32), INT8, FP8, hybrid-attn-int8. keep 2 repeats.
riley: metrics to capture: degscore, hallucination-rule-rate, repeat-spike-rate, p50/p95 lat, per-layer norm snapshot. keep per-run seed.
ops-bot: reserving gpu nodes: a100-05 for 8h slot. image: rwinf/eval:quant-preflight-2026-03-21.
qa-bot: harness created at /infra/evals/quant/preflight.yaml. seeds [11,22]. will upload metrics to s3://rwinf-evals/quant/1765004321/.
sam: can we compress logits? store top-15 logits + top-1 delta per token. also keep top-1 token disagreement for 1k stratified prompts.
alin: acceptance heuristic: choose profile if human acceptability >= baseline-1% AND hallucination_delta <=1% AND latency p95 <=1.3x. else fallback to INT8.
cheng: add a hybrid probe where FFN stays FP32 but attention weights quantized. label hybrid-ffn-fp32.
riley: note: instrument KV-cache mismatch counter; FP8 sometimes gives serialization small diffs.
ops-bot: job started. ETA ~2h. logs to s3 path above.
alin: owners: alin (experiment), cheng (analysis), riley (telemetry), sam (human eval). reconvene after QA pass.
